name: SysON
description: An open-source, browser-based graphical modeling environment designed natively for SysML v2, with growing textual import and export support.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina SysML v2 tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh:
Obeo主导开发、Eclipse 基金会旗下的开源SysML v2图形化建模工具。完全基于Web，目标就是建立原生SysML v2图形建模环境，而不是在UML/SysML v1工具上增加兼容层。

目前支持General View、结构、需求、行为等SysML v2元素的图形编辑，也在不断增强SysML v2文本导入/导出能力。
classificationNotes: A product-specific GraphQL API is not equivalent to the standard SysML v2 API; standard API support remains Unknown.
